summary: An unidentified skier in a group of eight was buried and killed by an avalanche triggered around 4 p.m. Tuesday in the Lindley Hut area near Aspen; a 911 call came in around 6 p.m. and rescuers recovered the body around 9 a.m. the next morning. The CAIC danger rating was considerable.
notes: Thornton Weather season recap (opened by parent at run 597; page's recap of the later Lindley Hut fatality). Date: story says the skier was killed 'Tuesday'; 2010-02-23 was a Tuesday.
